Round-1 plan-checker B-01: Plan 04 imports new strategy classes from src/strategy.py at module top. Had 03 and 04 both been Wave 2, parallel execution would race and fail at import. Promoted Plan 04 to Wave 3 (depends_on [05-01, 05-03]) and Plan 05 to Wave 4.

decisions.decision: Harness _run_one uses real OracleAgent + Anthropic client (NOT a MockOracle stub)
decisions.rationale: Round-1 plan-checker B-02: original plan stubbed _run_one with MockOracle(satisfied=True), making every strategy converge in 1 turn → zero between-strategy variance → bootstrap CI in Plan 05 cannot distinguish strategies → phase goal unachievable. Revised: real OracleAgent by default, MockOracle only under HARNESS_DRY_RUN=1.

decisions.decision: _format_message: empty payload is NOT a deviation
decisions.rationale: Round-1 W-02: original plan called deviation() on every empty-payload show_subset/ask_question. RandomStrategy emits empty payloads by design (Phase 2 baseline contract), so under STRICT_MODE=1 the entire 'random' column of the ablation matrix would abort. Revised: deviation() retained ONLY for genuinely unexpected branches (unknown cluster_id, missing item_id in id_to_text).

decisions.decision: Harness invokes run_baseline once per unique (persona, seed) — deduplicated across strategies
decisions.rationale: Round-1 W-01: original plan declared a key_link to run_baseline (D-10) but never invoked it. Without baseline rows the 'no_dialogue (baseline)' row of the D-14 output table would be empty. Revised: baseline_keys = sorted({(c.persona_id, c.seed) for c in combos}) → one baseline future per unique pair.

decisions.decision: Embedding store computed once in harness orchestrator (not per thread)
decisions.rationale: Round-1 W-04: original plan called EmbeddingStore.compute_and_save inside _run_one, causing up to 27 redundant embedding passes under 4 workers. Revised: _build_embedding_store(records) called once in run_harness; passed read-only to every _run_one call.

decisions.decision: Verify commands rewritten as portable python -c / subprocess one-liners
decisions.rationale: Round-1 W-03: Bash-only pipelines (grep | awk | && | >NUL) do not run on PowerShell (documented env shell on Windows 11). Plans 04 and 05 now use python -c invariant checks. Plans 01 and 03 still contain some grep -q calls but checker considered those out of scope for this fix.
